reviewedUnknownFormatExceptionSet.decision: Preserve unchanged as grandfathered legacy values; do not assign a region, fabricate a ledger, renumber, or permit these formats for new allocation.

decisionRules: Never create or update a link from matching number text automatically.
Never reinterpret gr_promotedjob or a historical Promoted stage as gr_registeredjob.
Never infer coordinator membership from Job type, status, number, ledger presence or historical promotion.
Never fabricate regional ledger rows for existing numbered Jobs; preserve them as grandfathered legacy Jobs unless separately reviewed source evidence is imported.
Leave existing coordinator membership unset and use the explicit legacy operational fallback; new registration writes false and reviewed Manage writes true.
The reviewed unknown-format exception set is identified only by count and fingerprint; any set drift is a stop condition.
Never renumber, clear, delete or move historical Job or ledger rows during analysis.
Every proposed one-to-one link requires an approved reviewed evidence file and exact row versions.
Any duplicate, mismatch, missing counterpart, malformed number or cross-region collision is a stop condition.
AutoNumber seed ownership and rollback must be approved independently of record linkage.
